q.zh: 為什麼 AI 特別愛用 GPU？
q.en: Why does AI love GPUs?

options.zh: GPU 能同時做大量簡單計算（平行運算）
options.en: GPUs do huge amounts of simple math at once (parallel computing)

explain.zh: AI 的運算大多是海量的簡單乘法和加法，GPU 有幾千個小核心可以一起算。
explain.en: AI is mostly vast amounts of simple multiply-and-add; a GPU's thousands of small cores work on it together.

q.zh: NVIDIA 的 CUDA 是什麼？
q.en: What is NVIDIA's CUDA?

options.zh: 讓工程師寫 GPU 程式的軟體工具
options.en: Software that lets engineers program GPUs

explain.zh: CUDA 2006 年推出，多年累積的程式和開發者，讓大家很難換別家晶片。
explain.en: Launched in 2006, CUDA's years of code and developers make switching chips hard.

q.zh: 「訓練」和「推論」有什麼不同？
q.en: What's the difference between training and inference?

options.zh: 訓練是教會 AI；推論是 AI 實際回答問題
options.en: Training teaches the AI; inference is the AI answering

explain.zh: 訓練是一次性的大工程；推論則是每次有人使用 AI 時都會發生。
explain.en: Training is a one-off mega project; inference happens every time someone uses the AI.

q.zh: AI 模型的「權重」是什麼？
q.en: What are a model's "weights"?

options.zh: 模型學到的知識，存成一大堆數字
options.en: What the model learned, stored as numbers

explain.zh: 權重（參數）就是 AI 的「腦內容」。開放權重模型會把這些數字公開下載。
explain.en: Weights (parameters) are the AI's brain contents; open-weight models publish them.

q.zh: 「開放權重」模型最大的好處是？
q.en: The biggest perk of an open-weight model?

options.zh: 可以下載到自己的機房執行、微調
options.en: You can run and fine-tune it on your own machines

explain.zh: 資料不必送到別人的雲端，也能依需求調整。這和「主權 AI」息息相關。
explain.en: Your data stays put and you can customize it — closely tied to sovereign AI.

q.zh: 「主權 AI」指的是？
q.en: What does "sovereign AI" mean?

options.zh: 國家想用自己掌握的機房與模型發展 AI
options.en: A country building AI on infrastructure and models it controls

explain.zh: 例如歐洲支持 Mistral Compute，就是不想完全依賴外國公司。
explain.en: Europe backing Mistral Compute is an example of not relying entirely on foreign firms.

q.zh: AI Agent 和一般聊天機器人最大的差別？
q.en: How does an AI agent differ from a chatbot?

options.zh: Agent 會自己規劃步驟、操作工具去完成任務
options.en: Agents plan steps and use tools to finish tasks

explain.zh: Agent 能寄信、改檔案、執行程式，所以安全更重要。
explain.en: Agents can send email, edit files and run code — which makes safety more important.

q.zh: 「提示注入」攻擊是怎麼運作的？
q.en: How does a prompt-injection attack work?

options.zh: 把壞指令藏在 AI 會讀到的內容裡，騙它照做
options.en: Hiding malicious instructions in content the AI reads
Putting a virus in the GPU

explain.zh: OWASP 把它列為大型語言模型應用的頭號風險；對 Agent 尤其危險。
explain.en: OWASP ranks it the top risk for LLM apps — especially dangerous for agents.

q.zh: 防範 AI Agent 出事，以下哪個是常見做法？
q.en: A common way to keep AI agents safe?

options.zh: 限制權限，讓它在沙盒裡執行並持續監控
options.en: Limit permissions, sandbox it, and monitor it
Let it roam free at night

explain.zh: 這正是 NVIDIA OpenShell 的思路：讓 Agent 在有規則的沙盒裡做事。
explain.en: That's the idea behind NVIDIA OpenShell: agents work inside a rule-bound sandbox.

q.zh: 什麼是「合成資料」？
q.en: What is synthetic data?

options.zh: 用電腦模擬產生、拿來訓練 AI 的資料
options.en: Data generated by simulation to train AI

explain.zh: 醫療資料難取得又涉及隱私，GE HealthCare 就用模擬環境訓練自動化 X 光與超音波。
explain.en: Medical data is scarce and private, so GE HealthCare trains autonomous imaging in simulation.

q.zh: Token（詞元）是什麼？
q.en: What is a token?

options.zh: AI 讀寫文字的最小單位
options.en: The smallest unit of text an AI reads or writes

explain.zh: 大約是一個中文字或半個英文單字，許多 AI 服務按 token 計費。
explain.en: Roughly one Chinese character or part of an English word; many AI services bill per token.

q.zh: 「微調」（Fine-tuning）是？
q.en: What is fine-tuning?

options.zh: 用專業資料把現成模型再加強訓練
options.en: Training an existing model further on specialist data

explain.zh: 例如拿通用模型，用醫療或法律資料微調，讓它更懂該領域。
explain.en: E.g. tuning a general model on medical or legal data so it masters that field.

q.zh: AI 機房現在常用什麼單位形容規模？
q.en: What unit now sizes AI data centers?

explain.zh: 1 GW 約等於一座大型發電廠。2025 年 OpenAI 與 NVIDIA 的意向書曾以「至少 10 GW」為目標（該意向書 2026 年據報已擱置）。
explain.en: 1 GW is roughly a large power plant. The 2025 OpenAI–NVIDIA letter of intent targeted at least 10 GW (that LOI was reportedly shelved in 2026).

q.zh: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 一個機櫃裡有幾顆 GPU？
q.en: How many GPUs are in one GB200 NVL72 rack?

explain.zh: 72 顆 Blackwell GPU 加 36 顆 Grace CPU，用 NVLink 串成「一顆超大 GPU」。
explain.en: 72 Blackwell GPUs and 36 Grace CPUs, linked by NVLink into one giant GPU.

q.zh: 為什麼新的 AI 機櫃需要液冷？
q.en: Why do new AI racks need liquid cooling?

options.zh: 一櫃約 120 千瓦，熱到風扇吹不走
options.en: ~120 kW per rack is too hot for fans

explain.zh: 冷卻液流過貼在晶片上的冷板，把熱直接帶走，也更省電。
explain.en: Coolant through cold plates carries heat straight off the chips, and saves energy.

q.zh: NVLink 的作用是？
q.en: What does NVLink do?

options.zh: 讓多顆 GPU 高速交換資料，像一顆大 GPU
options.en: Lets GPUs share data fast, like one big GPU

explain.zh: AI 模型太大，一顆 GPU 放不下，GPU 之間溝通的速度就變得非常關鍵。
explain.en: Models are too big for one GPU, so GPU-to-GPU speed becomes critical.

q.zh: AWS 的 Trainium 屬於哪一種晶片？
q.en: What kind of chip is AWS Trainium?

options.zh: ASIC：為 AI 特別設計的專用晶片
options.en: An ASIC: a custom chip built for AI

explain.zh: 專用晶片可能更省錢省電；大雲端通常 GPU 和自研晶片兩種都用。
explain.en: Custom chips can save cost and power; big clouds usually use both GPUs and their own chips.

q.zh: HBM（高頻寬記憶體）為什麼對 AI 很重要？
q.en: Why does HBM memory matter for AI?

options.zh: 模型很大，GPU 拿資料的速度常是瓶頸
options.en: Models are huge; feeding data to the GPU is often the bottleneck

explain.zh: 算得再快，資料送不進來也沒用；所以 HBM 和 GPU 一樣搶手。
explain.en: Speed is useless if data can't arrive in time — so HBM is as sought-after as GPUs.

q.zh: CoreWeave 在轉型做 AI 之前是做什麼的？
q.en: What did CoreWeave do before AI?

options.zh: 用 GPU 挖加密貨幣

explain.zh: 挖礦和訓練 AI 都靠 GPU 平行運算，所以設備和經驗可以直接轉用。
explain.en: Mining and AI both rely on GPU parallelism, so the gear and know-how carried over.

q.zh: 「Neocloud」主要在做什麼？
q.en: What do neoclouds mainly do?

options.zh: 專門出租 GPU 給 AI 公司

explain.zh: 像 CoreWeave、Lambda、Nebius，比大雲端更專注在 GPU 出租。
explain.en: Like CoreWeave, Lambda, Nebius — focused on GPU rental more than the big clouds.

q.zh: 2024 年 CoreWeave 有多少營收來自 Microsoft？
q.en: How much of CoreWeave's 2024 revenue came from Microsoft?

explain.zh: 營收高度集中在少數大客戶，是觀察 Neocloud 風險的重點。
explain.en: Heavy customer concentration is a key risk to watch in neoclouds.

q.zh: 2026 年 2 月，ChatGPT 每週有多少使用者？
q.en: How many weekly ChatGPT users were there in Feb 2026?

explain.zh: OpenAI 公布 9 億週活躍使用者與 5,000 萬付費訂閱。
explain.en: OpenAI reported 900M weekly users and 50M paying subscribers.

q.zh: 2025 年 NVIDIA 對 OpenAI 的「最多 1,000 億美元」投資，是哪一種協議？
q.en: NVIDIA's 2025 "up to $100B" OpenAI investment was what kind of agreement?

options.zh: 意向書，隨每 1 GW 上線分批投資
options.en: A letter of intent, investing as each gigawatt comes online

explain.zh: 意向書不是最終合約：2026 年 NVIDIA 改以 300 億美元股權入股，原意向書據報已擱置。新聞看到大數字時，要注意協議類型。
explain.en: A letter of intent isn't a final contract: in 2026 NVIDIA instead took a US$30B equity stake and the LOI was reportedly shelved. Always check the deal type behind big numbers.

q.zh: Anthropic 的「憲法式 AI」是什麼做法？
q.en: What is Anthropic's "Constitutional AI"?

options.zh: 讓 AI 依照一份寫好的原則清單自我檢討、修改回答
options.en: AI critiques and revises its answers against written principles

explain.zh: 規則寫得清楚、可公開檢視，也減少人工標註負擔。
explain.en: Explicit, reviewable rules and less human labeling.

q.zh: Anthropic 訓練和執行 Claude 用了哪些晶片？
q.en: Which chips does Anthropic use for Claude?

options.zh: NVIDIA GPU、Google TPU、Amazon Trainium 都有
options.en: NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs and Amazon Trainium

explain.zh: 同時使用多家晶片，可以分散風險、爭取更好的價格。
explain.en: Using several chip vendors spreads risk and improves pricing.

q.zh: AI 寫程式的「Coding Agent」階段，AI 會做什麼？
q.en: In the coding-agent stage, what does AI do?

options.zh: 自己規劃、修改多個檔案、跑測試
options.en: Plan, edit many files and run tests on its own

explain.zh: 從自動補完→對話→Agent，AI 做的事越多，人類把關越重要。
explain.en: Autocomplete → chat → agent: the more AI does, the more human review matters.

q.zh: 2026 年哪家公司收購了 Cursor？
q.en: Which company acquired Cursor in 2026?

explain.zh: 約 600 億美元的全股票交易，8 月完成後併入 SpaceXAI 部門。
explain.en: A ~$60B all-stock deal that closed in August, folding Cursor into SpaceXAI.

q.zh: 鴻海（Foxconn）在 AI 供應鏈扮演什麼角色？
q.en: What's Foxconn's role in the AI supply chain?

options.zh: 把 NVIDIA 晶片組裝成整櫃 AI 伺服器
options.en: Assembling NVIDIA chips into rack-scale AI servers

explain.zh: 2026 年第一季營收年增約 30%，主要靠 AI 伺服器需求。
explain.en: Q1 2026 revenue rose ~30%, driven by AI server demand.

q.zh: 2026 年第一季全球雲端市占第一名是？
q.en: Who led global cloud infrastructure share in Q1 2026?

explain.zh: Synergy Research 數據：AWS 約 28%、Microsoft 約 21%、Google Cloud 約 14%。
explain.en: Synergy Research: AWS ~28%, Microsoft ~21%, Google Cloud ~14%.

q.zh: 藥廠 Eli Lilly 用 1,000 多顆 NVIDIA B300 GPU 打造超級電腦，主要用來？
q.en: Eli Lilly built a 1,000+ B300 GPU supercomputer mainly to…

explain.zh: AI 可以先在電腦中篩選大量候選分子，縮短研發時間。
explain.en: AI can screen huge numbers of candidate molecules in silico, shortening R&D.

q.zh: AI 伺服器說「L11 出貨」是什麼意思？
q.en: What does an "L11 shipment" of AI servers mean?

options.zh: 整個機櫃組好、接好線並整櫃測試後出貨
options.en: A full rack built, cabled and tested as a whole

explain.zh: L6 是半成品、L10 是完整伺服器、L11 是整櫃、L12 是多櫃叢集。現在 AI 伺服器主力是 L11。
explain.en: L6 semi-finished, L10 full server, L11 full rack, L12 multi-rack cluster. AI servers now ship mostly at L11.

q.zh: 2026 年第二季，廣達單季營收大約多少？
q.en: Roughly what was Quanta's Q2 2026 revenue?

options.zh: 約 1.04 兆新台幣，首度單季破兆
options.en: About NT$1.04 trillion — its first quarter above NT$1 trillion

explain.zh: AI 伺服器帶動營收年增約一倍，但毛利率只有約 5%。
explain.en: AI servers roughly doubled revenue year on year — but gross margin was only about 5%.

q.zh: 代工廠改用「代料」模式後，最可能發生什麼事？
q.en: What's likely when a manufacturer switches to consignment?

options.zh: 帳上營收變少，但出貨不一定變少
options.en: Reported revenue falls, though shipments may not

explain.zh: 客戶自己買關鍵零件，代工廠只算組裝的錢。看營收數字時要注意這種會計口徑變化。
explain.en: The customer buys key parts, so the manufacturer books only its own share — watch for this when reading revenue figures.

q.zh: 雲端公司的「未完成訂單」代表什麼？
q.en: What does a cloud company's backlog represent?

options.zh: 已簽約、但還沒提供服務的金額

explain.zh: 像餐廳訂位本：還沒入帳，但代表未來的生意。截至 2026 年第二季：微軟商用剩餘履約義務約 6,780 億、Google Cloud 約 5,140 億、AWS 約 4,960 億美元。
explain.en: Like a reservation book: not revenue yet, but future business. As of the June 2026 quarter: Microsoft commercial RPO ~US$678B, Google Cloud ~US$514B, AWS ~US$496B.

q.zh: Google 第八代 TPU 為什麼拆成 8t 和 8i 兩顆？
q.en: Why did Google split its 8th-gen TPU into 8t and 8i?

options.zh: 分別針對訓練和推論最佳化
options.en: To optimize separately for training and inference

explain.zh: AI Agent 時代推論次數暴增，值得為推論專門設計晶片。
explain.en: Agents call models so often that inference deserves its own chip.

q.zh: Meta 為什麼在 2026 年簽下核電供應協議？
q.en: Why did Meta sign nuclear power deals in 2026?

options.zh: AI 資料中心需要大量、穩定的電力
options.en: AI data centers need huge, steady power

explain.zh: Prometheus 約 1 GW、Hyperion 未來可達 5 GW，電網一時供應不了。
explain.en: Prometheus is ~1 GW and Hyperion could reach 5 GW — more than grids can supply quickly.

q.zh: 「多模態」AI 指的是？
q.en: What is multimodal AI?

options.zh: 能同時理解文字、圖片、聲音、影片的 AI
options.en: AI that understands text, images, audio and video together

options.zh: 在很多台電腦上跑的 AI

explain.zh: Gemini 從設計之初就是多模態，Gemini 3 一次能讀約 100 萬個 token。
explain.en: Gemini was multimodal from the start; Gemini 3 reads about a million tokens at once.
